description.en: Describe a bug, let the agent reproduce it and fix it with tests, review the result and commit.
description.es: Describe un error, deja que el agente lo reproduzca y lo corrija con pruebas, revisa el resultado y confirma.

nodes.question: What is the bug? Describe what you expected and what happens instead.
Which file or area of {{projectName}} is affected? (leave a short hint, e.g. src/app.py)

nodes.message: Review the changes and the test results. Approve to commit, or reject to stop here.
